home.intro_text:
This is the third straight season I've written my guide and this version is by far the best yet. I've spent countless hours studying every team so I can give us the best chance of making money this season.

If you're just discovering me, the main thing you need to know is that absolutely everything I post is free. Here's a glimpse at what I'll be sharing with you throughout the NFL season…
features: Parlays, Flyers and Best Bets for every game week
Data Sheets to help you pick your own winners
Algorithms to identify the best matchups
home.closing_text: Whether you're a bettor, a fantasy football player or simply an NFL fan, this guide will give you more knowledge than all your buddies going into the 2025 season. Hope you enjoy it.
home.title: WELCOME TO MY NFL BETTING GUIDE 2026

picks.description: Despite throwing 41 touchdowns and over 4,100 yards last season, Lamar couldn't retain his MVP title. It was the first time he surpassed 4,000 passing yards and he only threw 4 interceptions as well. I suspect there was some voter fatigue but that shouldn't be an issue for him this season. The Baltimore offense remains one of the best in the NFL and the addition of DeAndre Hopkins gives Lamar another weapon.
